biological_replicate: a cohort of 43 obese individuals that had undergone 8 weeks of 12% body weight loss followed by a year of weight maintenance
technical_replicate: we measured quadruplicates of 319 plasma samples of the cohort
experimental_design: longitudinal monitoring of weight loss and weight maintenance
Longitudinal monitoring of the cohort revealed individual‐specific protein levels with wide‐ranging effects of losing weight on the plasma proteome
factor_value: time points (week -8, week 0, week 4, week 13, week 26, week 39, week 52)
Blood samples were taken before weight loss (week −8), directly after (week 0) and at five time points during weight loss (weeks 4, 13, 26, 39, 52)
number_of_technical_replicates: we measured quadruplicates of 319 plasma samples of the cohort
